newsitem.title: UK: TLG shares slide as warns on lower profits.
newsitem.headline: TLG shares slide as warns on lower profits.

text.p: Shares in light fitting group TLG Plc tumbled after it warned that market conditions had deteriorated and that it expected profits for the six months to Spet 30 of between 8.0 and 8.5 million stg from 11.4 million stg previously.
TLG shares were indicated 56-1/2p lower at 114p by 0716 GMT after hitting 95-1/2p earlier.

TLG said in a statement that at the time of its preliminary results in June it told shareholders that the economic outlook in Europe, particularly in Germany and France remained mixed and that this would impact the group's short term performance.
"Since then, the group's overall market share has remained strong but market conditions have deteriorated," it said.
However, TLG said it anticipated an improvement in its major markets in the second half of the year and that it would give a further update when it published its interim results in early December.
